```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

Nothing else in the repo refers to `emial`, so no other code needed changing. I haven't run the migration. If you want 0007 itself fixed, that only works for a database that has never run it, so tell me if that's really the case.
